soft watercolor picture-book illustration for young children, warm pastel colours, rounded friendly shapes, gentle golden light, clean uncluttered composition. Kavin the little elephant holding a big golden mango with his trunk under a mango tree, Mittu the parrot and Chinnu the squirrel smiling beside him. Grandpa Tortoise the tortoise: a gentle old tortoise with a domed olive-green shell with honey-coloured patterns, round spectacles and a soft white beard. Chinnu the palm squirrel: a tiny brown palm squirrel with three cream stripes down its back, a big fluffy tail and a small green satchel across its chest. Kavin the baby elephant: a small round baby elephant with soft blue-grey skin, big floppy ears with pink insides, a short curly trunk, bright curious eyes and a red-and-yellow striped scarf. Mittu the parrot: a little green parrot with a bright red curved beak, a yellow chest patch, blue-tipped wings and a tiny orange flower tucked behind one eye. Bright, cheerful, close-up and uncluttered, big happy faces, calm empty space for a title. No text, no letters, no words.
